# Files this branch is allowed to touch, enforced by tools/git-hooks/pre-push.
# PROJECT.md, CHANGELOG.md and this file are always allowed.
#
# `*` matches within one path segment; `**` crosses slashes. A pattern must
# reach a file: androidApp/**, not androidApp.
#
# If this branch adds a platform implementation, ARCHITECTURE.md § 2.7 requires
# a JVM fake under shared/ to ship with it — so include that path here too.
# Otherwise pre-push rejects the fake, and the easy way out is dropping a file
# the project requires rather than widening the scope.
androidApp/**
shared/feature/settings/**
shared/core/data/**
# Widened mid-branch: the settings entry point has to be drawn over the grid and
# under the viewer, which is a decision GalleryScreen owns, so it gained a
# `chrome` slot. One added parameter, no behaviour change for existing callers.
shared/feature/gallery/**
